components.title: Harbor Identity Service
components.description: Central identity service with MFA, access policy enforcement and quarterly access reviews. Provider responsibilities: Enforce MFA for provider privileged access. Disable provider accounts within 24 hours of termination notice.

components.title: Harbor Key Vault
components.description: Managed cryptographic key storage with access logging and scheduled rotation. Provider responsibilities: Manage platform key rotation every 180 days and restrict administrative access.

components.title: Harbor Backup Service
components.description: Encrypted scheduled backups and isolated restore testing for platform workloads. Provider responsibilities: Perform daily backups, retain 35 days, and test restoration quarterly.

components.title: Harbor Security Monitoring
components.description: Central event collection, daily triage and incident escalation for platform services. Provider responsibilities: Review platform alerts daily and retain searchable logs for 90 days. Escalate suspected platform incidents to the mission contact within one hour of triage.
